{{Quote|Hey, I just wanted to know why the History Department's bright star had to stay after class. Lemme guess: the maintenance droid broke down and you had to sort out Na'al's notes, right?|Herg to [[Pollo Tipn]]|<ref name="TTTSB" />}}
'''Herg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] student from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who studied under [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]. A classmate of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Pollo Tipn]], Herg had a arrogant personality and was prone to badgering Tipn with sarcastic remarks. After Tipn was asked to stay behind after class by Na'al, who intended to request his assistance for a mission to investigate reports relating to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], Herg mocked him and suggested Na'al had asked the other student to help with menial chores. To his surprise, Tipn revealed that the Professor had enlisted him for field work.<ref name="TTTSB" />
